title: Keep empty-queue Resume behind retired source-observation reconciliation
outcome: Public Resume of an empty paused queue drives pending retired source-observation recovery and only reports the queue unpaused after that reconciliation succeeds.
acceptance: Empty-queue Resume preserves retired source-observation reconciliation before unpause: a refusal keeps the queue paused with an accurate reason, and success finalizes the retained observation before reporting unpaused.
Regression coverage exercises empty paused queues with both successful and failed retired source-observation reconciliation.
